gate_results.gate_id: D2-006-G5: Cost drag <= 50% of gross PnL

observations: RETROSPECTIVE: this report was authored after execution as part of WP-6c. Metrics are transcribed from DEC-0007, the H-007 trial_log entry, and the H-007 experiment notebook. H-007 produced negative full-period Sharpe of -0.6416904457583815, max drawdown of 115.2341%, and cost drag of 422.3167% of gross PnL. The strategy failed 7 of 8 D2-006 gates; short exposure dominated, modeled fees and slippage overwhelmed the small gross PnL base, and DEC-0007 archived the candidate as a baseline NO-GO. Max-drawdown and cost-drag values are under pre-WP-5b pipeline semantics; per WP-5a/WP-5b audit conclusions the overall NO-GO verdict is unaffected by later pipeline fixes.
diagnostic_findings: The funding plus momentum composite did not repair the H-001 funding-directional failure mode.
Funding cashflows were favorable in aggregate, but modeled fees and slippage overwhelmed the small gross PnL base.
Short exposure dominated the baseline and the short leg was materially negative.
This result is evidence against this 4h funding-composite candidate, not against all derivative-market data streams.
Future funding-family work should require materially different risk control or selectivity rather than another direct funding-directional composite.
